name: Puchi Cherry ~Anata to Iru Kisetsu~
original_name: ぷちチェリー～あなたといる季節～
source:
Koichi returns to home town for the first time in ten years. Ten years changed characters of his old friends, but memories of the past remain the same. Will he find his loved person till school festival?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
浩一十年来首次回到故乡。十年改变了旧友的性格，往日的记忆却依旧如初。他能在学园祭前找到心爱之人吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
